en.title: Position before or after the noun
en.summary: Most English adjectives come before the noun.

paragraphs: Most English adjectives come before the noun. A few come after it, and some are used only after a verb.

An adjective follows words such as something and anyone. Adjectives like asleep and afraid are used only after a verb. When there are several adjectives, the usual order is opinion, size, age, colour, origin and material.
